w: In the evening assembly Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees of Augusta.

Mr. Mark Gibbons presented Swamishri, on behalf of the Mayor of Augusta, the Honorary Citizenship of the city of Augusta. Senator Mr. Charles Walker and Congressman Mr. Ben Harbin welcomed Swamishri with a bouquet of flowers.

No Spiritual Difference in Shriji Maharaj's Murtis A young boy, called Kirtan, who studies at the BAPS hostel in Abu, India, asked Swamishri, "Bapa, what is the difference between the murti of Ghanshyam Maharaj in Abu and the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj with you?" Swamishri replied, "There is no difference at all. They are one." Kirtan had observed that Swamishri's Thakorji - Lord Harikrishna Maharaj - is offered profuse devotion and receives maximum attention and respect from all. To satisfy a child's curiosity regarding the difference in his mind, Swamishri conveyed that though the murtis of Lord Swaminarayan may be different in name and form yet it is the same Shriji Maharaj who accepts the devotion and prayers of devotees in all of them.
It is useless not to eat once the food has been prepared. Similarly, after building such a beautiful mandir it is useless (for ourselves) if one does not do Satsang, bhakti and seva.

w: Bal - Balika Din On Bal-Balika Din the evening cultural programme began with a kirtan aradhana by the balaks. After Swamishri's arrival, they acted out various incidents from Swamishri's life that serve as examples for them to follow.

They also presented a drama about a poor shopkeeper who was unable to reap the benefits of a parasmani that had the capability to change metal to gold, simply because he failed to recognise its importance. The balaks then described how they have recognised the parasmani in the form of Swamishri, who transforms their lives into gold by inspiring them to lead moral lives. In his blessings to the assembly, Swamishri praised the efforts of the children. He also explained to all parents, "Everyone in the world puts great emphasis on educating their children, but in addition to this, if values are instilled in them then they will do great things, and will be able to serve society."

Anandpriya Swami phoned from London. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "There was an assembly commemorating the Suvarna Tula held in London twenty five years ago. You did not come to London, but the assembly went well."
Swamishri said, "We did come to the assembly there. Your eyes must have been elsewhere, so you did not see."

Nevil of Parujan came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj and have darshan. He prayed, "Swami! Please take me to Akshardham."
"We have come only to give Akshardham," Swamishri said with feeling.

After that, Pramodbhai Patel came for Swamishri's darshan. On 18 July 2017 he had phoned Sarvadarshandas Swami. What had happened was that a huge fire had broken out in Mariposa County. The fire was spreading with very strong winds. A situation had arisen in which the whole town could burn to ashes. The fire control department had instructed everyone to evacuate their homes, motels, everything. The fire was coming close to Pramodbhai's motel, a Best Western. About 1,200 firemen with around 200 fire trucks were standing by to control it. The motel had been evacuated. At that time the fire was heading in its direction. On the phone he said to Sarvadarshandas Swami, "We are in great trouble. If the fire reaches us, a great deal will be reduced to ashes. Recovery will take a long time, and the business will lose twelve thousand dollars a day. Please phone Swamishri. Please get us his blessings."

Sarvadarshandas Swami immediately messaged Vivekmurtidas Swami about this. Swamishri was in Chicago at that time. On learning of it, a call was put through to Pramodbhai, but he could not be reached. A call was put through to his son. Swamishri blessed him, saying, "Maharaj will protect you and all will be well."

And it was as if a miracle took place! The blazing fire did come at full force up to the motel, but a little way off it split neatly into two parts and the whole fire turned aside. Within a few minutes, the direction of the fire, which had been from west to east, changed to north and south west. The fire brigade too saw this miracle with their own eyes: the fire passed by without touching the motel, and the wind also stopped. And as it moved on, the fire died down too.

In this way, not only Pramodbhai's motel but the whole town was protected. The fire was so terrible that it burned one hundred and twenty thousand acres of forest, but by Swamishri's word the devotees, and because of them the whole town, were protected.
We have seen Swamishri's power over Indra, the god of rain, on many occasions. This was the first sight of his power over Agni, the god of fire!
